name: The beautiful one
reasons: Every visible element follows one rule: black surface, satin-silver structure and service points, clear glass-like coolant, one warm-white light
Glow turns the clear Pinions into lit panels and floats the frame on a wall halo; tinted glass keeps it calm by day
Three dashboards on ONE app (AIDA64): GAMSC on the CPU, flow/water-quality NEXT on the crossbar, an 8.8 in bar below the frame like a museum label
weak: +€884 over Best value for nothing that adds fps; the black/tinted Crow has 1 unit in stock
All 3 ARGB and all 3 USB 2.0 headers of the Dark Hero are used: nothing left for later; more leads in the wall gap

name: The powerful one
reasons: Fastest AM5 gaming CPU on sale (9850X3D) with 64 GB DDR5-6000 CL30: no CPU or RAM limit for years
Dark Hero VRM (20 stages, 51–57 °C with a 9900X) and HPE-45 radiators give headroom for PBO, a 390 W GPU limit and 30 °C summers
Flow + coolant temperature + water quality on the NEXT, with a flow alarm into a fan header
weak: +€1,577 over Best value for about 1% fps at 1440p (the 64 GB alone is +€768 at autumn-2026 DRAM prices)
HPE-45: +0.9 kg and fans 19 mm proud of the Pinions for at most 0.5 K, and only above ~1200 rpm

name: Best value
reasons: Same fps as Powerful within ~1% and the same loop quality: Alphacool fittings, HPE-30 with drains, QDs, two drain valves, clear acrylic
TOUGHFAN EX12 Pro: Noctua-class airflow at 20 dBA (Hardware Busters, 12 Pro twin) for €53.54 less, 2 cables for 6 fans
Gen5 T710 at the price of an SN850X; the GAMSC screen shows CPU and H2O (coolant probe on T_SEN1) with free InfoPanel; 9800X3D at 369 while the deal lasts
weak: MSI Carbon: dragon logo, 2 USB 2.0 headers, M2_2 halves the GPU slot, less VRM margin (no backplate)
Gold RM1000x (~15 W more at the wall than the Titanium DP14, 90-degree 12V-2x6 from Corsair, Style A/B) and a single 2.9 in dashboard: no flow reading or second screen
